metadata.description: The complete solo developer system: a full product team, a production audit/debug/fix toolkit (site-doctor), a dedicated SEO specialist layer (seo), a stack-aware layer, and a workflow layer (git, spec, repo intelligence, security, browser QA, quality gates, AI-agent orchestration with AgentRooms schema + memory steward, growth), unified by the standard 16-file .solo/ project memory that can sync out to Obsidian and Grafana (tokens via environment variables only; external writes are dry-run first and manual-only). 19 plugins (18 components + the full-team meta-plugin), 79 skills, 125 slash commands, 16 stdlib helper scripts, 24 room-* agents covering intake -> spec -> plan -> design -> build -> review -> test -> browser-QA -> audit -> gate -> release -> operate -> document -> sync, with /solo:full-team-dev running the whole 18-role cycle, /solo:self-check verifying the suite, strict evidence-based gates (/gate:production-ready scores 14 categories with an N/A-aware denominator (normalized /100) and machine-readable, self-attested, stale-rejecting gate evidence; /gate:score-project for the trend metric), and two-mode (connector/manual) vendor audits for Cloudflare, Vercel, Supabase, tags, and payments that run only for providers recorded in .solo/stack.md.

plugins.name: solo
plugins.description: The heart of the solo workflow: persistent .solo/ project memory across sessions, outward sync, whole-suite self-check, and full-team orchestration.

plugins.name: stack
plugins.description: Stack-aware auditing for Cloudflare, Vercel, Supabase, analytics tags, and payments. /stack:connector-check probes read-only and writes only local project memory.

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Planning for solo developers: PRD, architecture, and task breakdown. Product-manager and software-architect skills that write to shared .solo/ project memory.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design for solo developers: UX flows, UI review, and a lightweight component system. UI/UX-designer skill; complements site-doctor's accessibility, mobile, and forms audits.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Development for solo developers: implement features, fix bugs by root cause, refactor safely, and review code. Routes deep database and security work to site-doctor.

plugins.name: test
plugins.description: Testing for solo developers: unit, integration, e2e, and edge-case hunting. QA-engineer skill that tests against PRD acceptance criteria and keeps the test pyramid balanced.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Release for solo developers: pre-launch preflight, a safe ordered deploy plan, and a rollback plan prepared before deploying rather than during an incident.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Documentation for solo developers: README and docs upkeep, API reference, and a from-scratch setup guide, kept matched to code reality rather than to intent.

plugins.name: site-doctor
plugins.description: Production toolkit to audit, debug, and fix websites and databases - 27 skills across security, SEO, performance, accessibility, API, observability, and infrastructure.

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: Dedicated SEO specialist layer: technical, content, schema, sitemap, hreflang, local, maps, GEO/AI-search, e-commerce, and programmatic SEO, with one command per skill.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git and repository workflow: safe branch names, clean atomic commits, PR review, release notes, and GitHub issue sync against .solo/tasks.md.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Spec and planning: turn rough ideas into clear briefs, testable acceptance criteria, and API, data, and environment contracts before you build.

plugins.name: repo
plugins.description: Repo intelligence: understand a codebase before editing it - structure map, risk map, dependency map, dead-code finder, and onboarding guide. Read-only.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security: threat modeling, role/permission matrices, static Supabase RLS review, manual-only live test planning, redacted secret detection, and abuse-case analysis.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Real-browser QA: smoke-test core flows, catch console/network/hydration errors, review layout and responsiveness, test mobile breakpoints, and test forms end to end.

plugins.name: gate
plugins.description: Gates over self-attested, copyable evidence - not proof: /gate:before-code, /gate:before-merge, /gate:before-deploy, /gate:finalize-evidence, /gate:production-ready, /gate:score-project

plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: AI coding workflow: sharpen prompts, check agent handoffs, review AI-generated code for hallucinations, route tasks to the right model, and run rooms with 24 room-* agents.

plugins.name: growth
plugins.description: Growth: audit the conversion funnel and find where users drop off and why. Skill: conversion-optimizer (delegates measurement to site-doctor analytics/forms). Command: /growth:conversion-audit.

plugins.name: full-team
plugins.description: Meta-plugin that installs the complete solo-suite team in one step, declaring all 18 component plugins as dependencies.
